color.summary: Warm greys: #2c2c2b ink on a white page, #7d7a75 for muted text, a #f9f8f7 sidebar, and edges drawn as faint warm rings (rgba(42, 28, 0, 0.07), about #f0efed) rather than grey borders. Blue #2783de is the one strong color in the chrome (Start with this template, focus #2383e2). Content colors come from Notion's tag palette: pale fills under dark ink of the same hue. Dark mode is #191919 with #f0efed ink, #202020 cards and sidebar, #252525 menus.
usage: Links take the text's own color and weight, underlined, instead of blue.

type.summary: The system UI font (ui-sans-serif) everywhere in the app: 16px on a 24px line for page content, 14px for controls (500 for labels and primary buttons, 400 for quiet ones), 12px for metadata and property labels. Inline code is SFMono in a smaller size. The login page is the marketing face and uses Inter.

shape.summary: Small, consistent radii: 6px on buttons, menu rows and options, 10px on cards and menus, 12px on dialogs, 20px on the search palette. Tags are 3.5px rectangles; Status properties are full pills.

spacing.summary: Tight, on a 2px grid: 6 and 8px are the common gaps, then 12px. Controls are 28px, small ones 24px, view tabs 32px.

elevation.summary: Every edge is a 1px ring in box-shadow, so cards and menus have no real border. Cards add a faint 4px 12px drop; menus and popovers a softer 20px 24px one; the search palette and dialogs a deep 24px 48px shadow. In dark the ring is #383836.

button.summary: Mostly quiet: 28px buttons with 6px corners and no fill until hover, icon buttons for almost every action, labels at 14px. The blue primary appears once a page (Start with this template). Pages also hold Button blocks, outlined with an emoji. The markup names none of the looks.
